description: This PHP file defines administrative menu options and configuration links for SuiteCRM, including user management, system settings, module settings, email management, admin tools, and third-party integrations. It also includes access control logic based on user privileges.

classes.name: SugarOAuthServer
classes.description: A class managing OAuth server functionalities, specifically whether OAuth is enabled.

methods.name: SugarOAuthServer::enabled
methods.description: Static method to determine if OAuth server is enabled.

methods.name: getDeveloperModules
methods.description: Method of user object to get list of modules the current user has developer access to.

methods.name: is_admin
methods.description: Function to check if the current user has admin privileges.

methods.name: displayStudioForCurrentUser
methods.description: Function to determine if the Studio feature should be displayed for the current user.

methods.name: displayWorkflowForCurrentUser
methods.description: Function to determine if Workflow features should be shown for the current user.
